Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; WASECA AREA CAREGIVER SERVICES. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for Waseca Area Caregiver Services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WASECA AREA CAREGIVER SERVICES.

$120,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Waseca Area Caregiver Services. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
additions: $120,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Waseca Area Caregiver Services. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
